main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x (10-bar return - coin drift)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases summed per date

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: Welch t of signed excess return, |forecast| above minus below median

decided_by: The main measure's t lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Cases are grid bars (positions 0,10,20,... of each window) with forecast != 0 and a full 10-bar forward return in the window, drift is the coin's mean 10-bar return on that grid over all its windows, the t uses per-date summed deviations from the mean (clustered SE with J/(J-1) correction), and the median split puts |forecast| > median above and <= median below.
